result:
Fixed the regression in `anthrouter/http_util.py`. The header was misspelled as `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining`. It's now `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`, so the requests-remaining value is recorded again.

I re-ran only `tests/test_handlers.py` and `tests/test_admin.py`, not the full suite. The rate-limit tests that failed in the full run now pass, and so does the admin requests test.

Two failures remain in `tests/test_handlers.py`: `test_cached_tier_is_not_replayed_into_a_different_requested_tier` and `test_locked_baseline_scopes_the_tier_slot_by_the_lock`. They're about tier caching, not the rate-limit window, so I left them alone. I didn't check whether they predate the regression.

The full run also had a failure in `tests/test_config.py::test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields`. I didn't look at it or re-run it after the fix.
